name: ClickHouse
description: Bounded HTTPS SQL, typed ClickHouse metadata, table rows and confirmed database/table maintenance. No external driver required.

permissions.description: HTTPS requests to explicit ClickHouse origin; custom passwordSecret and builtin connection credentials are dynamic. Reads may access privileged metadata; confirmed operations create/drop/rename/truncate/optimize/insert. No files, environment discovery or automatic replay. Database grants and server policies govern effects; SQL guards are not a security sandbox.

Server readonly=1 and bounded results; database grants, allowed table functions and server policy remain actual security controls. Query guards are not a SQL sandbox. All operations require $retries=0 (or absent), explicit HTTPS origin and username, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD or configured passwordSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection credentials.username/password. Profile config is merged by the host. No ambient environment, filesystem, custom CA, TLS bypass, sessions, retries, polling or external table uploads.  Timeout 100–30000 ms, request/response <=1 MiB. Abort/disconnect does not establish cancellation; inspect server state before retry. ClickHouse and related marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of ClickHouse, Inc. or its affiliates. definitions.name: List ClickHouse Parts
definitions.documentation: List ClickHouse Parts. Official ClickHouse HTTPS SQL transport, one request only. Server readonly=1 and bounded results; database grants, allowed table functions and server policy remain actual security controls. Query guards are not a SQL sandbox. All operations require $retries=0 (or absent), explicit HTTPS origin and username, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD or configured passwordSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection credentials.username/password. Profile config is merged by the host. No ambient environment, filesystem, custom CA, TLS bypass, sessions, retries, polling or external table uploads. One ordered offset page, default 100/max 1000 items; fetches one extra row for hasMore. Concurrent changes can shift offsets. Timeout 100–30000 ms, request/response <=1 MiB. Abort/disconnect does not establish cancellation; inspect server state before retry. ClickHouse and related marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of ClickHouse, Inc. or its affiliates. This independent integration does not imply sponsorship or endorsement. One ordered offset page, default 100/max 1000 items; fetches one extra row for hasMore. Concurrent changes can shift offsets. Timeout 100–30000 ms, request/response <=1 MiB. Abort/disconnect does not establish cancellation; inspect server state before retry. ClickHouse and related marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of ClickHouse, Inc. or its affiliates. definitions.name: List ClickHouse Events
definitions.documentation: List ClickHouse Events. Official ClickHouse HTTPS SQL transport, one request only. Server readonly=1 and bounded results; database grants, allowed table functions and server policy remain actual security controls. Query guards are not a SQL sandbox. All operations require $retries=0 (or absent), explicit HTTPS origin and username, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD or configured passwordSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection credentials.username/password. Profile config is merged by the host. No ambient environment, filesystem, custom CA, TLS bypass, sessions, retries, polling or external table uploads. One ordered offset page, default 100/max 1000 items; fetches one extra row for hasMore. Concurrent changes can shift offsets. Timeout 100–30000 ms, request/response <=1 MiB. Abort/disconnect does not establish cancellation; inspect server state before retry. ClickHouse and related marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of ClickHouse, Inc. or its affiliates. This independent integration does not imply sponsorship or endorsement. definitions.name: List ClickHouse Disks
definitions.documentation: List ClickHouse Disks. Official ClickHouse HTTPS SQL transport, one request only. Server readonly=1 and bounded results; database grants, allowed table functions and server policy remain actual security controls. Query guards are not a SQL sandbox. All operations require $retries=0 (or absent), explicit HTTPS origin and username, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD or configured passwordSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection credentials.username/password. Profile config is merged by the host. No ambient environment, filesystem, custom CA, TLS bypass, sessions, retries, polling or external table uploads. One ordered offset page, default 100/max 1000 items; fetches one extra row for hasMore. Concurrent changes can shift offsets. Timeout 100–30000 ms, request/response <=1 MiB. Abort/disconnect does not establish cancellation; inspect server state before retry. ClickHouse and related marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of ClickHouse, Inc. or its affiliates. definitions.name: Create ClickHouse MergeTree Table
definitions.documentation: Create ClickHouse MergeTree Table. Official ClickHouse HTTPS SQL transport, one request only. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=CREATE_TABLE. Success means synchronous HTTP completion, not transactional multi-operation atomicity. All operations require $retries=0 (or absent), explicit HTTPS origin and username, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD or configured passwordSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection credentials.username/password. Profile config is merged by the host. No ambient environment, filesystem, custom CA, TLS bypass, sessions, retries, polling or external table uploads.  Timeout 100–30000 ms, request/response <=1 MiB. Abort/disconnect does not establish cancellation; inspect server state before retry. ClickHouse and related marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of ClickHouse, Inc. or its affiliates. This independent integration does not imply sponsorship or endorsement. definitions.name: Rename ClickHouse Table Result Encode
definitions.documentation: Pure reciprocal Rename ClickHouse Table Result codec. Optional absence, explicit null, falsy values and list ordering follow the pinned schema. No I/O, secrets or state; serialized values are limited to 1 MiB. Complete socket values are validated against the named immutable type.
definitions.code: function bounded(v){const stack=[[v,0,false]],active=new Set();let count=0;while(stack.length){const [x,d,exit]=stack.pop();if(exit){active.delete(x);continue;}if(d>90||++count>200000)throw Error('Value complexity bound');if(x===null||typeof x==='string'||typeof x==='boolean')continue;if(typeof x==='number'&&Number.isFinite(x))continue;if(!x||typeof x!=='object'||active.has(x)||!Array.isArray(x)&&![Object.prototype,null].includes(Object.getPrototypeOf(x)))throw Error('Finite acyclic JSON required');active.add(x);stack.push([x,d,true]);for(const y of Array.isArray(x)?x:Object.values(x))stack.push([y,d+1,false]);}if(Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(v))>1048576)throw Error('Value exceeds 1 MiB');return v;}const fields=["completed","submittedRows"],aliases={"completed":"completed","submittedRows":"submittedRows"},entries=Object.entries(inputs.remainder??{});for(const[k]of entries)if(fields.includes(k))throw Error('Remainder collision');for(const k of fields)if(Object.hasOwn(inputs,aliases[k])&&inputs[aliases[k]]!==undefined)entries.push([k,inputs[aliases[k]]]);return {value:bounded(Object.fromEntries(entries))};

definitions.name: Rename ClickHouse Table
definitions.documentation: Rename ClickHouse Table. Official ClickHouse HTTPS SQL transport, one request only. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=RENAME_TABLE. Success means synchronous HTTP completion, not transactional multi-operation atomicity. All operations require $retries=0 (or absent), explicit HTTPS origin and username, CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD or configured passwordSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection credentials.username/password. Profile config is merged by the host. No ambient environment, filesystem, custom CA, TLS bypass, sessions, retries, polling or external table uploads.  Timeout 100–30000 ms, request/response <=1 MiB. Abort/disconnect does not establish cancellation; inspect server state before retry. ClickHouse and related marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of ClickHouse, Inc. or its affiliates. This independent integration does not imply sponsorship or endorsement.
